turns.question: What share of candidates who applied in September 2026 reached the interview stage or beyond?
turns.answer: Of the 3 candidates who applied from 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30, 2 are now at the hired stage (past interview) and 1 was rejected; the semantic layer has no interview-reached rate metric and the rejected candidate's furthest stage is not available, so I can say 2 of 3 are confirmed at interview or beyond, but I have not computed a percentage. Late: recruitment.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
